description: Cogitate (2025): face versus object category was decoded across tasks in both posterior and prefrontal regions in iEEG, MEG and fMRI. Prefrontal decoding reached about 70% in iEEG but generalized only from about 0.2 to 0.4 s.
limitations: One adversarial study of visual consciousness with suprathreshold faces, objects, letters and false fonts. Tests only the predictions both teams preregistered.

sources.quote: Hence, across modalities, face–object decoding occurred in both posterior and prefrontal ROIs, consistent with IIT and GNWT predictions.
